attack_1_header_claimed_role.detail: Production rejected header-claimed role without valid Bearer token.

attack_2_forged_default_secret.detail: Refused startup or rejected forged token signed with default secret.

attack_3_legacy_lab_bypass.detail: Surprising lab draw forced through M3, creating observations, alerts, follow-up tasks, and audit logs.

attack_4_read_without_consent.detail: Clinician blocked with HTTP 403 Forbidden due to absent patient consent record.

attack_5_audit_row_tampering.detail: verify_audit_chain detected hash mismatch on modified historical audit row.

attack_6_tail_deletion.detail: Anchor comparison detected row count deficit and missing head hash.
